text:
Alejandra: quick follow-up from last night's incident — I'm doing a remediation rollup and proposing a small SLO/SLA tweak to reduce blast radius while infra changes land.
Matt: ack. what's the concrete change you're proposing?
Alejandra: propose p95 generation latency target -> 350ms (prev 300ms) for bursty endpoints; keep p99 at 1200ms. Error budget for timeout/503 class errors -> 0.4% monthly. This is temporary while we finish KV prefix caching + batching improvements.
Samir: :thinking_face: is that just to buy time for the cache and batch work?
Alejandra: yes. timeline below. plan = 2-week canary for the SLO change, continuous monitoring via dashboard (link) and a rollback plan if regressions appear. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/latency-remediation?from=now-14d
Matt: can you paste the alert rule you'd like us to add?
Alejandra: suggested composite alert: p95 > 400ms for 10m OR error rate > 0.6% for 5m -> page and post to #eng-oncall.
Matt: thinking out loud, alert expr: ```expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,route)) for: 10m labels: severity=high``` I'll formalize in the alerting PR.
Liz: who owns the rollout and runbook edits?
Alejandra: owners: Samir = infra (cache + batch shaping), Matt = dashboards & alerts, David = canary gating + deployment policy. I'll own the remediation tracker and the SLA proposal doc.
Samir: ack. I'll instrument per-model cache hit ratio, prefix hit counts, and add a per-model latency histogram.
David: for canary: we'll flip a runtime flag in prod for 10% traffic for 48h, measure p95/p99 and error surface, then 50% for 24h before full. rollback if p99 > baseline * 1.2 or error rate > 0.8%.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-314 linked to this thread — postmortem created by Alejandra
Liz: timeline? when do we kick off the canary?
Alejandra: target start: Tue 09:00 PT next week. 2-week observation -> decision point Fri of the following week. I'll add explicit timestamps into the tracker. tracker: https://redwood.internal/docs/remediation-rollup
Matt: also add a per-model QPS breakdown panel. last incident looked concentrated on one model variant.
Samir: good call — I'll add a per-model heatmap and run a 48h synthetic load (staggered) to validate KV cache behavior under production-like mix.
David: let's do a quick status sync on Friday EOD before the canary. 15m.
Alejandra: Friday 16:00 PT works for me. I'll update the runbook, add owners and rollback criteria, and open PRs for alerts/dashboards. Thanks all :thumbsup:
